title: feeder housing and idealized attachment reaction

loads.application: distributed remote moment and force on PF-05 local z=115 mm upper annular face

constraint: BC11 fixed lower flange annular face at PF-05 local z=0 mm
singularity_rule: report the fixed-edge peak separately; acceptance stress is evaluated at least two local fine elements from the fixed boundary
limitations: PF-04 is suppressed in the attachment solve because the source model has intentional running clearance and no bearing/bushing body
fastener holes, bracket, aluminum profile and table are absent; BC11 is a fixed-interface surrogate
linear static simulation does not validate cyclic fatigue, jam impact, fastener slip or physical assembly
